text: We design graphics processors and accelerated computing platforms used in gaming, data centers and autonomous vehicles.
New export controls restrict shipments of our data center GPUs to certain countries, which could reduce demand for our products in those regions.
We face intense competition from semiconductor companies and cloud providers developing their own AI accelerators and custom chips.
Supply chain constraints at third-party foundries could delay the manufacturing of our wafers and increase costs.
Our business model combines hardware such as iPhone and Mac with services like the App Store, iCloud and Apple Music.
Total net sales for fiscal 2024 were 12,345 million, according to the consolidated statements of operations.
Total net sales for fiscal 2023 were 11,111 million, according to the consolidated statements of operations.
Our production capacity depends on the ramp of our gigafactories in Texas, Berlin and Shanghai.
Disruptions in our supply chain for battery cells and raw materials could limit vehicle production.
We are subject to regulatory scrutiny regarding competition law, data privacy and artificial intelligence in multiple jurisdictions.
We report three business segments: North America, International and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
We continue to increase capital expenditures on artificial intelligence infrastructure, including servers and data centers.
As of the end of the fiscal year, we had approximately 99,999 employees worldwide.
